findings.summary: SYNTHESIS: SEC filings confirm The Limited's 1995 credit agreement contained Unrestricted Subsidiary carve-outs for entities 'exclusively in the business of owning or leasing aircraft' and 'primarily as a carrier transporting goods.' Web research confirms SAT was explicitly contracted to fly cargo for The Limited. The credit agreement mechanism (private designation notice to agent) means any SAT-related subsidiary would never appear in public filings. Zero aviation entities appear in any Exhibit 21 from FY1994-FY2005. Ohio SoS shows zero Limited-connected entities at Rickenbacker. The Unrestricted Subsidiary mechanism was structurally capable of hiding an aviation relationship but no direct evidence proves designation occurred.

findings.summary: SAT FAA fleet identified: 7 core aircraft registered to Southern Air Transport Inc, PO Box 52-4093 Miami International Airport. Fleet was primarily Lockheed C-130 Hercules military cargo variants + one Boeing 707-369C cargo. 'SJ' suffix = 'Southern Jet' callsign. Last action dates cluster 1996-1998 (consistent with bankruptcy). Also found: Pan-Southern Air Transport Inc (Dallas TX) with Douglas DC-3A deregistered 1998, and Southern Air Inc (Norwalk CT, acquired by Oak Hill Capital 2007) — corporate successor operating Boeing 747 freighters on military CRAF contracts, bankrupt 2012. Modern 'Southern Air Transport Services LLC' (Dover DE, 2022) operates a single Cessna 180H — no operational connection.
